pairs.ask: Coach Rule Cleanup: When a rule changes, quote the old version or just the new?

optionA.label: Quote The Old
optionA.desc: The rulebook keeps the old wording quoted under the new rule.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#C1502E"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">RULE CHANGE NOTES</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Quote The Old</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The rulebook keeps the old wording</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">quoted under the new rule.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Just The New
optionB.desc: Only the current rule stays; history lives in git.

pairs.ask: Coach Rule Cleanup: Shelf of five decks, hard cap or Allow a sixth for urgent decks?

optionA.label: Hard Cap
optionA.desc: Never more than five decks; an urgent deck replaces the oldest.

optionB.desc: An urgent deck may sit as a sixth until it is answered.
